info.title: Kavosh One Foundation API
info.description: Tested backend foundation and human identity APIs, not a complete academy/accounting platform. Bots use scoped bearer credentials; verified humans use host-only HttpOnly sessions plus X-Academy-Id, with membership and current role grants checked server-side. Cookie-authenticated mutations require exact APP_ORIGIN. Explicit denial wins. All sensitive responses are no-store.

botBearer.description: Expiring kvo_ opaque credential. Store securely and send in Authorization; never use query parameters.

humanSession.name: __Secure-kavosh.session_token
humanSession.description: Opaque HttpOnly signed cookie set by login/MFA, never read or stored by frontend JavaScript. Local HTTP development uses kavosh.session_token.

academySelection.name: X-Academy-Id
academySelection.description: Academy UUID; selecting it does not grant membership or permission.

idempotency.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotency.description: Reuse for retries of this exact operation. Changed payload returns 409. Permission is rechecked on replay.

after.name: after
after.description: Pass nextCursor from the preceding result.

error.description: Error: 400 invalid input/reference, 401 unauthorized, 403 forbidden, 409 idempotency conflict, 413 oversized body, 415 wrong content type, 429 rate limit or 503 unavailable. Body contains error.code and error.requestId; X-Request-Id is also returned. No stack traces, tokens or database details are exposed.

list.description: JSON object with data array and nextCursor (UUID or null). All records are permission-filtered.

post.description: Provider-only authentication, not a human session or bot token. Off until operator configuration, registered school/region/environment/client identity and isolated ingest database role are verified. HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + dot + original bytes; current/previous endpoint-specific secret and fixed 300-second freshness window. A strict Verification probe may be unsigned but performs no database call. Repeated identical event IDs deduplicate; differing authenticated bytes retain the original and record one critical conflict per digest. Private signer content is not retained. No live provider verification or enrolment eligibility is implied.

parameters.name: X-BoldSign-Signature
parameters.description: Required for every data event. Provider HMAC header; only the strict no-data Verification probe is exempt.

parameters.name: X-BoldSign-Event
parameters.description: When present must match the signed eventType; Verification enables only the strict unsigned probe.

schema.description: Original UTF-8 JSON bytes, at most 1 MiB. Data events require a valid X-BoldSign-Signature and configured environment/client identity. Only an X-BoldSign-Event: Verification probe with no data is unsigned and side-effect free. Document objects require documentId. Unknown provider fields are discarded, not retained.
